items.title: NVIDIA replaces CEO amid China AI and robotics concerns
items.summary: NVIDIA is replacing co-founder Jensen Huang with Collette Kress as CEO and Harvey C. Jones as board chair as it faces trade scrutiny. The post NVIDIA replaces CEO amid China AI and robotics concerns appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: 由于对中国人工智能和机器人技术的担忧，英伟达更换了首席执行官
items.summary_zh: 由于面临贸易审查，NVIDIA 将任命 Collette Kress 为首席执行官，Harvey C. Jones 为董事会主席，取代联合创始人黄仁勋。 NVIDIA 因对中国人工智能和机器人技术的担忧而更换首席执行官的消息首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: Viam Launchpad aims to accelerate robotics deployments
items.summary: The Viam Launchpad is intended to provide the software and engineering infrastructure to help startups bring robots to commercial deployment. The post Viam Launchpad aims to accelerate robotics deployments appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: Viam Launchpad 旨在加速机器人技术部署

items.title: Runway’s Praxis-1 world action model for robotics is now available
items.summary: Runway launched Praxis-1 with partners including Noble Machines, Standard Bots, and Ultra. Developers can now use it with open weights. The post Runway’s Praxis-1 world action model for robotics is now available appeared first on The Robot Report .

items.summary_zh: Runway 与 Noble Machines、Standard Bots 和 Ultra 等合作伙伴共同推出了 Praxis-1。开发人员现在可以将其与开放权重一起使用。 Runway 的 Praxis-1 机器人世界行动模型现已推出，首先出现在《机器人报告》上。
